name: Trigenys Engineering OS
tagline: A file-based toolkit for agent skills, safe installation and collaboration across Cursor, Claude Code and Codex.
problem: Engineering workflows drift when separate agents copy prompts, overwrite existing skill folders and silently assume common runtime state.
scenario: A maintainer selects an installation scope, dry-runs the skill and adapter install, reviews any differences, then adopts canonical RAIDER rules without overwriting local customizations.
differentiation: 44 specialist skills, agent profiles and a separate index adapter are delivered as transparent versioned files; the installer is dry-run-first and preserves differences unless updates are explicitly allowed.
architecture: Canonical RAIDER standard -> skill inventory + adapter index -> local install checker -> selected tool roots (.claude, .agents, .cursor) -> tracked Git coordination and proof-of-done.
limitations: No cross-vendor live model orchestration, cloud provisioning or deployed TEOS API is provided; generated Node server is an AppFactory scaffold only.
